scenario: instrumented animated desktop with microphone status panel
limits: Instrumentation adds 100 ms sampling, 5 second process discovery and a 16 ms heartbeat.
Paint FPS counts QWidget paints, not physical display presentation; event-loop lateness is not visual drag latency.
Sub-100 ms peaks and descendants shorter than 5 seconds may be missed; use benchmark_microphone.py/benchmark_speech.py for audio worker measurements.
Includes matching Windows venv launcher parent; excludes invoking shell.
GPU/compositor memory not measured. Microphone finish state alone does not prove physical capture or recognition occurred.
Working-set sum may count shared pages more than once.
